services.heading: Engineering for Sovereign Food Systems
services.subheading: From custom agroecological architectures to community-owned digital public infrastructure, we offer mission-aligned software engineering.
services.s1Desc: Tailored software design and engineering for Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), seed conservancies, and bio-regional trusts. We craft bespoke workflows that mirror ecological reality.
services.s2Desc: Designing community-owned data registries, localized seed schemas (seeds_master), and open-source protocols ensuring smallholders maintain strict data sovereignty.
services.s3Desc: End-to-end infrastructure provisioning on Google Cloud & Firebase with strict data residency, privacy, local caching, and zero extractive vendor lock-in.

research.heading: Indigenous Agrarian Voice AI & Open Commons
research.subheading: Breaking digital literacy barriers through natural spoken voice recognition in under-represented indigenous dialects.
research.asrTitle: Vernacular Agrarian Speech Recognition (ASR): Iruliga & Lambani (Gor-Boli)
research.asrCopy1: Literacy barriers should never lock smallholder and indigenous women farmers out of digital ecological monitoring. Standard commercial speech models fail completely on regional tribal dialects and colloquial agronomic terms.
research.asrCopy2: Buffalo Back Labs is pioneering open acoustic fine-tuning and domain-specific dataset curation for Iruliga (forest-dwelling agrarian communities of Bannerghatta and Nilgiris) and Lambani / Gor-Boli (nomadic pastoralist and dryland farming communities across Karnataka).
research.openCommonsDesc: All core schemas, offline PWA service worker patterns, and seed registry protocols are published openly under permissive licenses on GitHub for the agroecological movement.

about.heading: Technology Subservient to Ecology
about.subheading: Buffalo Back Labs (OPC) Private Limited is an ecosystem-anchored software lab founded to build sovereign, non-extractive digital tools for the soil.
about.p1: Conventional AgTech is designed for monocultures, commodity traders, and debt-driven contract farming. At Buffalo Back Labs, we invert this paradigm. We design software around the complex physics of polycultures, women-led collective stewardship, and bioregional food sheds.
about.p2: We believe in honest, transparent technology. As a modern engineering studio, we harness advanced AI acceleration to build enterprise-grade software at grassroots speed — but every feature, data schema, and workflow is co-created and tested with farmers on the ground at our Ragihalli Living Lab.
about.val1Desc: Technology must nurture ecological biodiversity and community autonomy, never extract value.
about.val2Desc: Farmers and grassroots collectives own 100% of their operational, seed, and yield data.
about.val3Desc: AI-accelerated development audited transparently and field-verified with boots on the ground.
